title: Customer Order Gap Alert (30–60 Days)
description:
Find customers whose **last order was between 30 and 60 days ago** (inclusive) relative to the most recent order date in the table. Return them along with the days since their last order.

**Table: customers** — `customer_id`, `customer_name`

**Table: orders** — `order_id`, `customer_id`, `order_date`

Output columns: `customer_id`, `customer_name`, `last_order_date`, `days_since_last_order`. Order by `days_since_last_order`.
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id INTEGER, customer_name VARCHAR); CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INTEGER, customer_id INTEGER, order_date DATE); INSERT INTO customers VALUES (1,'Alice'),(2,'Bob'),(3,'Charlie'),(4,'Diana'),(5,'Eve'),(6,'Frank'),(7,'Grace'),(8,'Henry'); INSERT INTO orders VALUES (1,1,'2024-04-05'),(2,2,'2024-03-10'),(3,3,'2024-02-20'),(4,4,'2024-02-10'),(5,5,'2024-01-15'),(6,6,'2024-04-15'),(7,7,'2024-03-15'),(8,8,'2024-04-05');
solution_sql: WITH max_date AS (SELECT MAX(order_date) AS max_dt FROM orders), last_orders AS (SELECT o.customer_id, c.customer_name, MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order_date FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY o.customer_id, c.customer_name) SELECT lo.customer_id, lo.customer_name, lo.last_order_date, (md.max_dt - lo.last_order_date) AS days_since_last_order FROM last_orders lo, max_date md WHERE (md.max_dt - lo.last_order_date) BETWEEN 30 AND 60 ORDER BY days_since_last_order;

test_cases.description: Max date is 2024-04-15. Bob (36 days), Grace (31 days), Charlie (55 days) fall in 30-60 range

hints: Find the table's most recent order date in a CTE using MAX(order_date).
Compute days_since_last_order as max_dt - last_order_date (DuckDB returns INTEGER for DATE subtraction).
Use BETWEEN 30 AND 60 to filter the gap window.
explanation: The max order date is 2024-04-15. Alice (Apr 5): 10 days — too recent. Bob (Mar 10): 36 days ✓. Charlie (Feb 20): 55 days ✓. Diana (Feb 10): 65 days — too far. Eve (Jan 15): 91 days — too far. Frank (Apr 15): 0 days. Grace (Mar 15): 31 days ✓. Henry (Apr 5): 10 days. Three customers fall in the 30–60 day window.
